dedupe_keys.name: public transport feed scraper and stable re publication pipeline

description: This repository runs scrapers that republish selected official transit feeds under stable URLs. Its README lists Germany-wide and North Rhine-Westphalia GTFS and NeTEx schedules, a German stop registry, Hamburg GTFS, Luxembourg GTFS and NeTEx, and Sweden-wide GTFS. Each listing points to the source provider, the stated feed licence and a stable mirror URL. The tree contains JavaScript fetchers, linked-data conversion code and continuous-integration workflows, making this a reusable data-preparation pipeline, not a new authoritative timetable. The code licence grants use and redistribution with notice; the separate feed licences range across CC BY, CC0 and German attribution terms. Coverage spans selected European national and regional feeds, and refresh timing is not specified in the inspected README. A limitation is that mirrors may lag or break when upstream portals change, and no feed bytes or live mirror freshness were checked. Simulation use includes obtaining and normalising timetable inputs. It complements data-transitland, which indexes many feeds, and the respective provider records where present.
